name: ShapeBlock – Powerful Gutenberg Blocks to Build Better Websites Faster
author: ShapeKode

sections.description:
ShapeBlock adds 80+ blocks with ShapeBlock Pro to the WordPress block editor, plus a Header & Footer Builder.

Every block has the same three tabs: Settings for the content, Layout for columns, alignment and spacing, and Style for colours, typography, borders, shadows and hover effects. Sizes, spacing and columns can be set separately for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Demo | Docs | Roadmap | Upgrade to Pro

Starter Templates

Import a complete website – pages, header, footer, menu and images – in a few clicks from ShapeBlock > Templates, or add a single page, section, header or footer from the Templates button in the block editor. Preview each template on desktop, tablet and phone first. See how it works, step by step:

View All Templates

Key Features

  • 80+ blocks with Pro for layouts, content, media, navigation and marketing.
  • Starter Templates – import a complete website or a single ready-made page in a few clicks.
  • Header & Footer Builder with Include and Exclude display conditions, for classic and block themes.
  • Fully responsive – separate desktop, tablet and mobile values, and hide any block per device.
  • Full design control – typography, gradients, borders, shadows, spacing and a built-in icon picker.
  • Custom Templates – build a layout once and reuse it anywhere with a shortcode.
  • Lightweight – each block loads its files only on pages that use it, and unused blocks can be switched off.
  • Export & Import – move your settings and templates between sites in one file.
  • Privacy friendly – no tracking unless you opt in, no CDN, and Google Fonts stays off until you turn it on.

Want more? Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

ShapeBlock Pro adds 42+ more blocks (80+ blocks with the free ones): 32 Pro blocks, 8 animation blocks and 3 WooCommerce blocks, plus 2 builders and 9+ extensions:

  • Theme Builder – design single posts, pages, archives, search results and the 404 page with 13 dynamic blocks.
  • Popup Builder – popups built with blocks, opened on page load, on scroll, on exit intent or on a click.
  • Mega Menu – wide dropdown panels built from any blocks.
  • WooCommerce Builder – your own product, shop, cart and checkout pages, plus Product Grid and Product Carousel.
  • Motion Effects – entrance, scroll and mouse animations for any block.
  • 8 animation blocks – Animation Title, Typewriter, Rotating Text, Scroll Text, Horizontal Scroll and more.
  • Display Conditions – show or hide any block by user, role, date, time, page or device.
  • Custom Code – Google Analytics, Tag Manager, a pixel or a live chat in your header or footer, without editing a theme file.
  • Marquee, Table of Contents, Image Hotspot, Flip Box, Hero Slider, Timeline, Advanced Data Table and more Pro blocks.

Free Blocks

  1. Accordion – Collapsible question and answer sections.
  2. Breadcrumb – Shows visitors where they are on the site.
  3. Business Hours – Opening hours for each day, with today highlighted and an Open now or Closed now badge that follows the site time.
  4. Button – Buttons with icons, sizes and hover styles.
  5. Call to Action – A title, a short line and one or two buttons, in six layouts, with an image, an icon or a background picture.
  6. Client Logo – A grid of client or partner logos with links, grayscale and hover-swap.
  7. Column – A column inside a Row, with its own width per device.
  8. Contact Info – Phone, email, address and more, each linked to the right app.
  9. Countdown – Counts down to a date and time.
  10. Counter – Animated number counters.
  11. Divider – Lines between sections, with text or an icon in them.
  12. Drop Caps – A paragraph that opens with a large first letter, in four styles, with optional columns.
  13. Features List – Feature lists with icons.
  14. Filterable List – A list of links with icons, filter buttons, badges and a search box.
  15. Google Map – A Google map of one place or several, with a list of the places, directions links and a gray, dark or warm look.
  16. Heading – Headings with typography, gradient and highlight options.
  17. Hover Box – An image or icon in a circle or square that shows a title and description on hover.
  18. Icon Box – Icon, heading and text together, in several layouts, with an optional button (text, icon or icon only).
  19. Icon List – A list where each item gets its own icon.
  20. Icon – A single icon with colour, size and link.
  21. Image Carousel – Several images at once, with centred slides and continuous scrolling.
  22. Image Comparison – Before / after images with a draggable handle, labels and several handle styles.
  23. Isotope Filter – A filterable grid with category buttons and an optional search box.
  24. Menu – Shows a WordPress navigation menu with layout, alignment and colour options.
  25. Offcanvas – Slide-in panels for menus, sidebars or extra content.
  26. Paragraph – Text with its own colour, typography per device, alignment and highlighted words.
  27. Post Grid – Posts in grid layouts, with pagination.
  28. Pricing Table – Pricing plans with features, badges and a button.
  29. Progress Bar – Animated progress and skill bars.
  30. Row – A responsive row that holds Column blocks, boxed, full width or a custom width.
  31. Scroll Top – A back-to-top button.
  32. Search – A search field you can put anywhere.
  33. Simple Gallery – An image gallery with spacing and column controls, and a popup with a choice of animations.
  34. Slider – A full-width image slider with arrows, dots and autoplay.
  35. Social Icon – Linked social icons, coloured all together or one by one.
  36. Social Share – Share buttons for the current page.
  37. Sticky Stack – Cards that stick as you scroll and stack over one another.
  38. Table – Tables with styled headers, rows and cells.
  39. Tabs – Tabbed content with icons and a few tab styles to pick from.
  40. Team Member – Team members with photo, role and social links.
  41. Testimonial – Testimonials in three styles, with ratings, quote icons and logos.

Header & Footer Builder

Build your header and footer in the block editor – no child theme and no PHP. Then pick where each one shows up with display conditions: Entire Site, Front Page, All Pages, All Posts, All Archives, Search Results, 404 Page, or specific pages and posts. Any condition can be set to Include or Exclude.

It works with classic and block themes. Pages that match none of your conditions keep the theme’s own header and footer. There’s also a Custom Block type you can place anywhere with the [shapeblock_builder] shortcode.

ShapeBlock Pro

Everything above is free and stays free. ShapeBlock Pro is a separate add-on that works on top of this plugin. It adds 42+ blocks (32 Pro blocks, 8 animation blocks and 3 WooCommerce blocks), 2 builders and 9+ extensions.

Pro Blocks (32)

  1. Advanced Accordion – sections that hold any blocks.
  2. Advanced Button – buttons with eight hover animations.
  3. Advanced Data Table – sort, search and page through a table.
  4. Clients Logo Slider – logos in a carousel or endless marquee.
  5. Comparison Table – plans side by side with ticks and prices.
  6. Flip Box – a box that turns over on hover.
  7. Hero Slider – full-width slides with heading and buttons.
  8. Image Hotspot – markers on an image that open popups.
  9. Marquee – text, logos, icons or any blocks moving in an endless line.
  10. Masonry Gallery – photos packed into tight columns.
  11. Mega Menu – wide dropdown panels built from blocks.
  12. Post Carousel – posts as cards in a slider.
  13. Price Menu – names, prices and short descriptions.
  14. Rating – stars, a score and a short note.
  15. Table of Contents – a list of the page headings that marks the section on screen.
  16. Team Member Carousel – your team in a sliding row.
  17. Testimonial Slider – customer reviews with stars, photos and logos, in four layouts.
  18. Timeline – a story step by step along a line.
  19. Video Player – YouTube, Vimeo or your own video, inline or popup.
  20. Post Title – the title of every post (Theme Builder).
  21. Featured Image – the featured image of every post (Theme Builder).
  22. Post Content – the text and blocks of every post (Theme Builder).
  23. Post Excerpt – a short summary of every post (Theme Builder).
  24. Post Meta – author, date, categories and comments (Theme Builder).
  25. Post Categories / Tags – the terms of every post (Theme Builder).
  26. Author Box – the author with photo and bio (Theme Builder).
  27. Post Pagination – links to the previous and next post (Theme Builder).
  28. Post Comments – comments and the comment form (Theme Builder).
  29. Related Posts – more posts from the same category (Theme Builder).
  30. Archive Title – the title of blog and category pages (Theme Builder).
  31. Archive Description – the description of a category or tag (Theme Builder).
  32. Archive Posts – the posts of a blog, category or search page (Theme Builder).

Animation Blocks (8)

  1. Animation Title – rotating words, drawn highlights and entrance effects.
  2. Animation Text – text that comes in letter by letter.
  3. Typewriter Effect – words that type themselves.
  4. Rotating Text – text turning in a circle.
  5. Scroll Text – big text that slides as you scroll.
  6. Image Reveal Effect – an image uncovered by a curtain.
  7. Image Scroll Trigger – an image that zooms or moves on scroll.
  8. Horizontal Scroll – a row that moves sideways on scroll.

WooCommerce Blocks (3) – need WooCommerce

  1. Product Grid – your products in a grid.
  2. Product Carousel – your products in a slider.
  3. WooCommerce Builder – product, shop, cart and checkout pages from 15 blocks.

Builders & Extensions (11)

  1. Theme Builder – Single Post, Page, Archive, Search and 404 templates.
  2. Popup Builder – popups built with blocks, on load, scroll, exit or click.
  3. Motion Effects – entrance, scroll and mouse animations for any block.
  4. Display Conditions – show or hide blocks by user, date, page or device.
  5. Parallax Background – a row background that moves slower than the page.
  6. Copy Style – copy one block’s look and paste it on others.
  7. Preloader – a loading screen, with your own logo.
  8. Scroll to Top – a back-to-top button on every page.
  9. Smooth Scrolling – gliding scroll and a styled scrollbar.
  10. Custom Cursor – a dot and ring that follow the mouse.
  11. Custom Code – code in the header, after the opening body tag or in the footer, such as Google Analytics or a live chat.

Also in Pro: Post Grid Filter adds category tabs, Load More and infinite scroll to the free Post Grid.

Get ShapeBlock Pro

Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

External services

ShapeBlock connects to an outside service only in the cases below.

Google Fonts (optional, off by default)

Only after you turn it on under ShapeBlock > General: font files load from Google (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), which receives the visitor’s IP address, and the editor’s font list is fetched once a week from fonts.google.com by your server. By Google LLC: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Appsero (only if you allow it)

Only if you click Allow: once a week your site sends api.appsero.com its URL and name, the admin email, first and last name, the WordPress, PHP and MySQL versions, locale, theme, the number of users and of active and inactive plugins, and the server IP (looked up from icanhazip.com). Without Allow nothing is sent, except a deactivation reason you type, and only when you click Submit & Deactivate. Appsero Privacy Policy, icanhazip FAQ.

ShapeBlock template library (only when you open it)

Only when you open Templates in the block editor or ShapeBlock > Templates: your site asks the ShapeBlock template server (https://shapekode.com/product/shapeblock/demo-template/) for the list of templates and their preview images and, when you insert or import one, its block content. Importing a whole template can also download its demo content file (blog posts, media, menus) and its settings from the same server. The requests are made by your server and send your site’s address (as the request origin). If Copy images to Media Library is ticked, the template’s images are downloaded from the same server. Live previews open the template’s demo site in your browser. By ShapeKode: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Gravatar (Post Grid author picture)

When a Post Grid shows the author picture, it loads from Gravatar, which receives the visitor’s IP. By Automattic Inc.: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Google Maps (Google Map block)

On a page with a Google Map block, the map loads from Google Maps, which receives the visitor’s IP (with Load on Click, only after the visitor clicks). By Google LLC: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Social Share and Social Icon links

Plain links to Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit and the other networks you add; nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one, and then that network receives the page address and title.

Source code and build process

Every compiled file in the plugin ships with its readable source right beside it, except the Menu block, which is written by hand and has no build step:

  • Blocks: includes/public/blocks/<block>/src/, built into the build/ folder next to it. The Menu block is hand-written in includes/public/blocks/menu/build/ and has no build step.
  • Admin dashboard: src/ in the plugin root, built into build/.
  • Stylesheets: assets/css/style.scss, includes/public/assets/css/public.scss and assets/lib/bootstrap/bootstrap-grid.scss, each built beside its source.

Built with @wordpress/scripts and Dart Sass. To rebuild: npm install, then npm run build and npm run build:<block> (all script names are in package.json).

Credits

ShapeBlock is licensed GPLv2 or later and includes these MIT-licensed libraries:

  • Swiper 12.0.3 (https://swiperjs.com) – assets/lib/swiper/LICENSE, unmodified release files.
  • Bootstrap 5.3 grid (https://getbootstrap.com) – assets/lib/bootstrap/LICENSE, only the grid, recompiled with a shapeblock- prefix.
  • Ant Design 6 and Ant Design Icons (https://ant.design) – assets/lib/antd/LICENSE, used only in the admin dashboard.
  • Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1 (https://icons.getbootstrap.com) – includes/public/assets/font/bootstrap-icons-LICENSE.txt, the icons of the built-in icon picker.
  • Appsero Client 2.0 (https://github.com/Appsero/client) – includes/appsero/LICENSE, the opt-in usage data client described under External services.

The icon fonts were made with Fontello (https://fontello.com). Our own icons are GPLv2 or later; three come from Font Awesome 4.7 and Elusive Icons under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), listed in includes/public/assets/icon/config.json, with the licence and notices in includes/public/assets/font/OFL-LICENSE.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for “ShapeBlock” and click Install Now.
  2. Activate ShapeBlock from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open any post or page and add a ShapeBlock block from the block inserter.
  4. Optional: visit ShapeBlock > Blocks to turn off blocks you won’t use.
sections.faq:
Will it work with my theme?

Yes, with any well-coded theme, including block themes. The blocks pick up your theme’s typography, and you can restyle them from the block settings.

Do I have to use all 80+ blocks?

No. Turn off any you don’t need in ShapeBlock > Blocks. A block that’s off isn’t registered and its files aren’t loaded.

Can I replace my theme’s header and footer?

Yes. Build one in ShapeBlock > Theme Builder and set where it should appear. Pages that don’t match your conditions keep the theme’s own header and footer.

Does ShapeBlock send any data to outside servers?

Not by default. See External services above.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Deleting the plugin removes the options and cached data it created. Your Custom Templates, Theme Builder items and the blocks in your posts are your content, so they stay.

1.1.2

  • New: Call to Action block – a title, a short line and one or two buttons to turn visitors into customers, in six layouts: stacked, text beside the buttons, image left, image right, background picture with an overlay, and a card. Add an image or an icon, a small label above the title and a ribbon across the corner; link the whole box as well as each button (new tab and nofollow for each). Texts are typed right on the block; colours, gradients, typography, padding, alignment, content width, height, borders, shadows and a lift, zoom or grayscale hover effect, per device where it matters.
  • Fixed: Tabs – an icon next to the tab title now sits in the middle of the text instead of a few pixels low.
  • Fixed: Business Hours – a long time or note (“7:00 AM – 11:00 AM, pickup only”) wraps onto a second line on phones instead of running off the screen.
  • Fixed: Menu – a menu with no mobile menu keeps its dropdowns inside the screen on phones, so the page no longer scrolls sideways.
  • Fixed: Paragraph – a letter spacing of 0 on highlighted words now applies, instead of keeping the paragraph’s own spacing.
  • Fixed: Countdown – hours, minutes and seconds always show two digits (03, not 3), so the numbers stay the same width as they tick.

1.1.1

  • New: Divider block – a line between sections in seven styles (solid, double, dashed, dotted, wave, zigzag and slashes), painted with a colour or a gradient. Put text or an icon in the line, at the start, the middle or the end, and type the text right on the block. Width, alignment, weight, pattern size and spacing for each device; the icon can be plain, stacked or framed; the text gets its own colour, typography, background and rounded corners.
  • New: Contact Info block – phone, email, address, WhatsApp, website or plain text rows, each with its own icon and a link that opens the right app (call, mail, Google Maps, a WhatsApp chat or the website), or a link of your own. As a list (with an optional line between rows), a grid with columns per device, or in one row; the icon left or on top, plain, stacked or framed. Labels and values are typed right on the block; card background, border, shadow, hover colours and a lift on hover, plus typography and spacing per device.

1.1.0

  • Added: Social Share – an Alignment option (left, center or right, per device) for the row of buttons.
  • New: Business Hours block – opening hours for each day (open and close times, Closed, Open 24 hours or your own text such as “By appointment”), 12 or 24 hour time, today’s row highlighted with a Today label, and an Open now / Closed now badge that follows the site time zone and updates by itself (hours past midnight count for the next morning). Every text, the hours included, is typed right on the block in the editor (“8 AM – 7 PM”, “Closed”, “Open 24 hours” or your own words). Side by side or stacked rows, a dotted line between day and time, row dividers, every second row shaded, and colour, gradient, typography, spacing, border and shadow settings per device, plus the Advanced tab.
  • Fixed: Post Grid – in the list layouts a photo set to 100% width (for example on phones) now puts the text under it instead of squeezing it out.
  • Fixed: Post Grid – the meta line now follows the Content Alignment (centred posts get a centred date and category).
  • Fixed: Post Grid – in the numbered list the date now lines up with the number.
  • Added: Post Grid – a “Badge on the Photo” switch: the category badge sits in the top corner of the photo instead of beside the date.
  • Improved: Menu – a parent item now shows the active colour when one of its sub-menu items is the page being viewed.
  • Added: Category colour – each category can have its own colour (Posts > Categories); Post Grid category badges use it as their background, so every topic gets its own colour.
  • Added: Column – a “Zoom Background on Hover” switch: the background image grows a little while the pointer is over the column.
  • Improved: Post Grid – the photo hover effect (zoom or slide) now starts when anywhere on the card is hovered, not only the photo.
  • Added: Post Grid – a “Show Icons” switch for the date, author and other meta, so the meta can start on the same line as the title.
  • Improved: A font installed on the site (in the WordPress Font Library or the theme) is no longer requested from Google Fonts when a block uses it; WordPress already loads it from the site.

1.0.9

  • New: Button – a Link type: a plain text link with no box, as wide as its text, for “Read more →” style links.
  • New: Paragraph block – text in a single paragraph, with colour, link colour, typography per device (desktop, tablet, mobile), alignment and highlighted words, plus the Advanced tab (margin, padding, position, hide per device). Its styles come from the block settings through the page stylesheet, so no style attributes are written into the page.
  • New: Heading – a P (paragraph) option in the HTML tag list, for descriptions, labels and other text that is not a heading. A theme’s paragraph margins stay off it; the block’s own Margin setting still applies.
  • New: SEO – a default meta description on every page: a post’s or page’s excerpt (or the start of its text), the site tagline on the front page, a category’s or tag’s description, an author’s bio. Pages get the Excerpt box so a description can be written by hand. It is not added when the theme or another plugin already prints one, and steps aside on its own when an SEO plugin (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, Slim SEO, Squirrly, SmartCrawl) is active.
  • New: Template Library – a template, page, section or whole demo that uses a ShapeForms form now brings that form with it: the form is created in ShapeForms (an identical one from an earlier import is reused) and the imported content points to it. Needs ShapeForms to be active.
  • New: Icon List – a “Link label” for a linked item that shows only an icon, read out by screen readers.
  • Improved: Text is printed in paragraphs instead of plain boxes, which is better for SEO and screen readers: the FAQ answer, Gallery caption and description, Pricing Table ribbon, description and button note, Search popup title, Table caption, Team Member designation and bio, Testimonials name and quote, and Post Grid excerpt. They look exactly as before, on the site and in the editor.
  • Improved: Block editor – CSS written into the page itself (in a Custom HTML block) and into the Theme Builder header and footer shown around it now applies in the editor too, so the page looks the same while it is edited as it does on the site.
  • Improved: SEO – the automatic excerpt WordPress builds from a page now includes the text of ShapeBlock Heading and Paragraph blocks (inside Rows and Columns too), so themes and SEO plugins that use it get a real description instead of none.
  • Improved: Every tag now does its own job, for SEO, keyboard and screen-reader users – with no change to how anything looks:
    • Lists are lists: Social Icons, Social Share, Feature List, Client Logo and the Breadcrumb trail (now a navigation with an ordered list).
    • Controls are buttons: Offcanvas open and close, Scroll to Top, Search open and close, the Gallery lightbox close, Social Share copy, Team Member social and popup close, Table tooltips. Tabs work with the keyboard (arrow keys, Home, End) and FAQ questions are headings with a button inside.
    • Links and icon-only buttons have names: Social Icons, Social Share, Gallery images, linked Client logos, Icon and Button (new “Link label” / “Accessible label” fields), Post Grid pagination.
    • No style attributes in the page: Social Icon, Isotope, Progress, Sticky Stack, Table, sticky Rows and the Filter List badge print their colours and sizes through the stylesheet.
    • Post Grid date day is no longer a heading; post images and avatars have alt text.
  • Fixed: Heading and Paragraph – a typography value of 0 (a letter spacing of 0, say), which the page leaves to the theme, no longer applies in the editor, so the text looks the same in both.
  • Fixed: Accessibility attributes (tab order, dialog and pressed states) were removed from blocks placed inside a Row or Column.
  • Fixed: Block styles were missing on pages that render blocks after the page head (a template library preview, for one) when a block in the head – a top bar, say – had already printed its styles: the page showed without its layout, colours and sizes.
  • Fixed: Menu – each menu on a page has its own name for screen readers (“Menu”, “Menu 2″…), so the navigation areas can be told apart.
  • Fixed: Menu – a dropdown near the right edge of the screen opens to the left of its item (and its side flyouts too), so it is never cut off and a closed dropdown no longer lets the page be dragged sideways on phones.
  • Fixed: Icon List – a title set to a heading or paragraph tag is no longer placed inside a span, which made the HTML invalid.
  • Fixed: Team Member – a photo without alt text of its own is described by the member’s name, so a linked photo is never an empty link.
  • Fixed: Post Grid – “Underline Title on Hover” draws a real underline under every line of a title that wraps, each as long as its own text, also on titles cut to a number of lines; the extra hover line that showed on every grid, whatever the setting, is gone.

  • Security: Pricing Table – the old price colour and the features and button alignment are checked before they go into the page’s styles.

  • Improved: the check for a bulk plugin activation reads its flag through a filter.
  • Improved: the bundled usage-data client (Appsero) has its own ShapeBlock namespace and hook names, so it no longer clashes with another plugin’s copy.

1.0.3

  • Fixed: The Advanced tab’s padding, margin and background now show in the editor for every ShapeBlock block, not only on the page.
  • Improved: In the editor, Ctrl+click (Cmd+click on a Mac) on a link inside a ShapeBlock block opens it in a new tab; a plain click still only selects the block.
  • New: Table – edited in place like the core Table block: type in the cells, add and remove rows and columns from the toolbar, and a new table asks for its column and row count.

  • New: Table – sidebar like the core Table: Layout (Default or Stripes) and Style with Global (text colour, background, cell border, typography, padding) for the whole table and Cell for the clicked cell; Icon List blocks in cells.
  • Improved: Table – the List View names each section Header, Body or Footer.
  • Improved: Table – a simpler sidebar: Settings and Style, in plain words; a clicked cell’s own settings come first.
  • New: Table – a tooltip for any cell, set in the cell’s settings; a new table has a light border round every cell.
  • Improved: Table – turning a cell’s Tooltip on opens all its settings right there: text, icon, position, icon colour, size and margin, background and text colour. The tooltip’s icon colour, size and margin work with its default icon too, the tooltip has its own background and text colour, and it is never cut off by the table’s edge.
  • Fix: Table – an Icon List in a cell keeps its own icon size; a border with no colour picked shows in light grey instead of not at all; a cell holding a block no longer shows an empty “Add text here” line in the editor.

  • New: Tabs – each tab’s content is blocks: type in it, or add or drag in any block. Tab titles are typed in the tab bar, and the + at its end adds a tab. Existing tabs keep their content.

short_description: 80+ Gutenberg blocks with Pro - sliders, grids, tabs, counters and more - plus a Header & Footer Builder, with per-device controls.
description:
ShapeBlock adds 80+ blocks with ShapeBlock Pro to the WordPress block editor, plus a Header & Footer Builder.

Every block has the same three tabs: Settings for the content, Layout for columns, alignment and spacing, and Style for colours, typography, borders, shadows and hover effects. Sizes, spacing and columns can be set separately for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Demo | Docs | Roadmap | Upgrade to Pro

Starter Templates

Import a complete website – pages, header, footer, menu and images – in a few clicks from ShapeBlock > Templates, or add a single page, section, header or footer from the Templates button in the block editor. Preview each template on desktop, tablet and phone first. See how it works, step by step:

View All Templates

Key Features

  • 80+ blocks with Pro for layouts, content, media, navigation and marketing.
  • Starter Templates – import a complete website or a single ready-made page in a few clicks.
  • Header & Footer Builder with Include and Exclude display conditions, for classic and block themes.
  • Fully responsive – separate desktop, tablet and mobile values, and hide any block per device.
  • Full design control – typography, gradients, borders, shadows, spacing and a built-in icon picker.
  • Custom Templates – build a layout once and reuse it anywhere with a shortcode.
  • Lightweight – each block loads its files only on pages that use it, and unused blocks can be switched off.
  • Export & Import – move your settings and templates between sites in one file.
  • Privacy friendly – no tracking unless you opt in, no CDN, and Google Fonts stays off until you turn it on.

Want more? Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

ShapeBlock Pro adds 42+ more blocks (80+ blocks with the free ones): 32 Pro blocks, 8 animation blocks and 3 WooCommerce blocks, plus 2 builders and 9+ extensions:

  • Theme Builder – design single posts, pages, archives, search results and the 404 page with 13 dynamic blocks.
  • Popup Builder – popups built with blocks, opened on page load, on scroll, on exit intent or on a click.
  • Mega Menu – wide dropdown panels built from any blocks.
  • WooCommerce Builder – your own product, shop, cart and checkout pages, plus Product Grid and Product Carousel.
  • Motion Effects – entrance, scroll and mouse animations for any block.
  • 8 animation blocks – Animation Title, Typewriter, Rotating Text, Scroll Text, Horizontal Scroll and more.
  • Display Conditions – show or hide any block by user, role, date, time, page or device.
  • Custom Code – Google Analytics, Tag Manager, a pixel or a live chat in your header or footer, without editing a theme file.
  • Marquee, Table of Contents, Image Hotspot, Flip Box, Hero Slider, Timeline, Advanced Data Table and more Pro blocks.

Free Blocks

  1. Accordion – Collapsible question and answer sections.
  2. Breadcrumb – Shows visitors where they are on the site.
  3. Business Hours – Opening hours for each day, with today highlighted and an Open now or Closed now badge that follows the site time.
  4. Button – Buttons with icons, sizes and hover styles.
  5. Call to Action – A title, a short line and one or two buttons, in six layouts, with an image, an icon or a background picture.
  6. Client Logo – A grid of client or partner logos with links, grayscale and hover-swap.
  7. Column – A column inside a Row, with its own width per device.
  8. Contact Info – Phone, email, address and more, each linked to the right app.
  9. Countdown – Counts down to a date and time.
  10. Counter – Animated number counters.
  11. Divider – Lines between sections, with text or an icon in them.
  12. Drop Caps – A paragraph that opens with a large first letter, in four styles, with optional columns.
  13. Features List – Feature lists with icons.
  14. Filterable List – A list of links with icons, filter buttons, badges and a search box.
  15. Google Map – A Google map of one place or several, with a list of the places, directions links and a gray, dark or warm look.
  16. Heading – Headings with typography, gradient and highlight options.
  17. Hover Box – An image or icon in a circle or square that shows a title and description on hover.
  18. Icon Box – Icon, heading and text together, in several layouts, with an optional button (text, icon or icon only).
  19. Icon List – A list where each item gets its own icon.
  20. Icon – A single icon with colour, size and link.
  21. Image Carousel – Several images at once, with centred slides and continuous scrolling.
  22. Image Comparison – Before / after images with a draggable handle, labels and several handle styles.
  23. Isotope Filter – A filterable grid with category buttons and an optional search box.
  24. Menu – Shows a WordPress navigation menu with layout, alignment and colour options.
  25. Offcanvas – Slide-in panels for menus, sidebars or extra content.
  26. Paragraph – Text with its own colour, typography per device, alignment and highlighted words.
  27. Post Grid – Posts in grid layouts, with pagination.
  28. Pricing Table – Pricing plans with features, badges and a button.
  29. Progress Bar – Animated progress and skill bars.
  30. Row – A responsive row that holds Column blocks, boxed, full width or a custom width.
  31. Scroll Top – A back-to-top button.
  32. Search – A search field you can put anywhere.
  33. Simple Gallery – An image gallery with spacing and column controls, and a popup with a choice of animations.
  34. Slider – A full-width image slider with arrows, dots and autoplay.
  35. Social Icon – Linked social icons, coloured all together or one by one.
  36. Social Share – Share buttons for the current page.
  37. Sticky Stack – Cards that stick as you scroll and stack over one another.
  38. Table – Tables with styled headers, rows and cells.
  39. Tabs – Tabbed content with icons and a few tab styles to pick from.
  40. Team Member – Team members with photo, role and social links.
  41. Testimonial – Testimonials in three styles, with ratings, quote icons and logos.

Header & Footer Builder

Build your header and footer in the block editor – no child theme and no PHP. Then pick where each one shows up with display conditions: Entire Site, Front Page, All Pages, All Posts, All Archives, Search Results, 404 Page, or specific pages and posts. Any condition can be set to Include or Exclude.

It works with classic and block themes. Pages that match none of your conditions keep the theme’s own header and footer. There’s also a Custom Block type you can place anywhere with the [shapeblock_builder] shortcode.

ShapeBlock Pro

Everything above is free and stays free. ShapeBlock Pro is a separate add-on that works on top of this plugin. It adds 42+ blocks (32 Pro blocks, 8 animation blocks and 3 WooCommerce blocks), 2 builders and 9+ extensions.

Pro Blocks (32)

  1. Advanced Accordion – sections that hold any blocks.
  2. Advanced Button – buttons with eight hover animations.
  3. Advanced Data Table – sort, search and page through a table.
  4. Clients Logo Slider – logos in a carousel or endless marquee.
  5. Comparison Table – plans side by side with ticks and prices.
  6. Flip Box – a box that turns over on hover.
  7. Hero Slider – full-width slides with heading and buttons.
  8. Image Hotspot – markers on an image that open popups.
  9. Marquee – text, logos, icons or any blocks moving in an endless line.
  10. Masonry Gallery – photos packed into tight columns.
  11. Mega Menu – wide dropdown panels built from blocks.
  12. Post Carousel – posts as cards in a slider.
  13. Price Menu – names, prices and short descriptions.
  14. Rating – stars, a score and a short note.
  15. Table of Contents – a list of the page headings that marks the section on screen.
  16. Team Member Carousel – your team in a sliding row.
  17. Testimonial Slider – customer reviews with stars, photos and logos, in four layouts.
  18. Timeline – a story step by step along a line.
  19. Video Player – YouTube, Vimeo or your own video, inline or popup.
  20. Post Title – the title of every post (Theme Builder).
  21. Featured Image – the featured image of every post (Theme Builder).
  22. Post Content – the text and blocks of every post (Theme Builder).
  23. Post Excerpt – a short summary of every post (Theme Builder).
  24. Post Meta – author, date, categories and comments (Theme Builder).
  25. Post Categories / Tags – the terms of every post (Theme Builder).
  26. Author Box – the author with photo and bio (Theme Builder).
  27. Post Pagination – links to the previous and next post (Theme Builder).
  28. Post Comments – comments and the comment form (Theme Builder).
  29. Related Posts – more posts from the same category (Theme Builder).
  30. Archive Title – the title of blog and category pages (Theme Builder).
  31. Archive Description – the description of a category or tag (Theme Builder).
  32. Archive Posts – the posts of a blog, category or search page (Theme Builder).

Animation Blocks (8)

  1. Animation Title – rotating words, drawn highlights and entrance effects.
  2. Animation Text – text that comes in letter by letter.
  3. Typewriter Effect – words that type themselves.
  4. Rotating Text – text turning in a circle.
  5. Scroll Text – big text that slides as you scroll.
  6. Image Reveal Effect – an image uncovered by a curtain.
  7. Image Scroll Trigger – an image that zooms or moves on scroll.
  8. Horizontal Scroll – a row that moves sideways on scroll.

WooCommerce Blocks (3) – need WooCommerce

  1. Product Grid – your products in a grid.
  2. Product Carousel – your products in a slider.
  3. WooCommerce Builder – product, shop, cart and checkout pages from 15 blocks.

Builders & Extensions (11)

  1. Theme Builder – Single Post, Page, Archive, Search and 404 templates.
  2. Popup Builder – popups built with blocks, on load, scroll, exit or click.
  3. Motion Effects – entrance, scroll and mouse animations for any block.
  4. Display Conditions – show or hide blocks by user, date, page or device.
  5. Parallax Background – a row background that moves slower than the page.
  6. Copy Style – copy one block’s look and paste it on others.
  7. Preloader – a loading screen, with your own logo.
  8. Scroll to Top – a back-to-top button on every page.
  9. Smooth Scrolling – gliding scroll and a styled scrollbar.
  10. Custom Cursor – a dot and ring that follow the mouse.
  11. Custom Code – code in the header, after the opening body tag or in the footer, such as Google Analytics or a live chat.

Also in Pro: Post Grid Filter adds category tabs, Load More and infinite scroll to the free Post Grid.

Get ShapeBlock Pro

Upgrade to ShapeBlock Pro

External services

ShapeBlock connects to an outside service only in the cases below.

Google Fonts (optional, off by default)

Only after you turn it on under ShapeBlock > General: font files load from Google (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), which receives the visitor’s IP address, and the editor’s font list is fetched once a week from fonts.google.com by your server. By Google LLC: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Appsero (only if you allow it)

Only if you click Allow: once a week your site sends api.appsero.com its URL and name, the admin email, first and last name, the WordPress, PHP and MySQL versions, locale, theme, the number of users and of active and inactive plugins, and the server IP (looked up from icanhazip.com). Without Allow nothing is sent, except a deactivation reason you type, and only when you click Submit & Deactivate. Appsero Privacy Policy, icanhazip FAQ.

ShapeBlock template library (only when you open it)

Only when you open Templates in the block editor or ShapeBlock > Templates: your site asks the ShapeBlock template server (https://shapekode.com/product/shapeblock/demo-template/) for the list of templates and their preview images and, when you insert or import one, its block content. Importing a whole template can also download its demo content file (blog posts, media, menus) and its settings from the same server. The requests are made by your server and send your site’s address (as the request origin). If Copy images to Media Library is ticked, the template’s images are downloaded from the same server. Live previews open the template’s demo site in your browser. By ShapeKode: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Gravatar (Post Grid author picture)

When a Post Grid shows the author picture, it loads from Gravatar, which receives the visitor’s IP. By Automattic Inc.: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Google Maps (Google Map block)

On a page with a Google Map block, the map loads from Google Maps, which receives the visitor’s IP (with Load on Click, only after the visitor clicks). By Google LLC: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Social Share and Social Icon links

Plain links to Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit and the other networks you add; nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one, and then that network receives the page address and title.

Source code and build process

Every compiled file in the plugin ships with its readable source right beside it, except the Menu block, which is written by hand and has no build step:

  • Blocks: includes/public/blocks/<block>/src/, built into the build/ folder next to it. The Menu block is hand-written in includes/public/blocks/menu/build/ and has no build step.
  • Admin dashboard: src/ in the plugin root, built into build/.
  • Stylesheets: assets/css/style.scss, includes/public/assets/css/public.scss and assets/lib/bootstrap/bootstrap-grid.scss, each built beside its source.

Built with @wordpress/scripts and Dart Sass. To rebuild: npm install, then npm run build and npm run build:<block> (all script names are in package.json).

Credits

ShapeBlock is licensed GPLv2 or later and includes these MIT-licensed libraries:

  • Swiper 12.0.3 (https://swiperjs.com) – assets/lib/swiper/LICENSE, unmodified release files.
  • Bootstrap 5.3 grid (https://getbootstrap.com) – assets/lib/bootstrap/LICENSE, only the grid, recompiled with a shapeblock- prefix.
  • Ant Design 6 and Ant Design Icons (https://ant.design) – assets/lib/antd/LICENSE, used only in the admin dashboard.
  • Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1 (https://icons.getbootstrap.com) – includes/public/assets/font/bootstrap-icons-LICENSE.txt, the icons of the built-in icon picker.
  • Appsero Client 2.0 (https://github.com/Appsero/client) – includes/appsero/LICENSE, the opt-in usage data client described under External services.

The icon fonts were made with Fontello (https://fontello.com). Our own icons are GPLv2 or later; three come from Font Awesome 4.7 and Elusive Icons under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), listed in includes/public/assets/icon/config.json, with the licence and notices in includes/public/assets/font/OFL-LICENSE.txt.

shapeblock/divider.description: A line between sections: solid, dashed, dotted, double, wave, zigzag or slashes, with text or an icon in it.

shapeblock/icon.name: shapeblock/icon
shapeblock/icon.title: Icon
shapeblock/icon.description: A single icon with color, size, background, border, rotation and link.

shapeblock/countdown.name: shapeblock/countdown
shapeblock/countdown.title: Countdown
shapeblock/countdown.description: A countdown timer to a target date with days/hours/minutes/seconds, custom labels, separators and full styling.

shapeblock/layout-row.name: shapeblock/layout-row
shapeblock/layout-row.title: Row
shapeblock/layout-row.description: A flexible row container that holds columns. Build any layout with responsive presets, flexbox controls and per-device styling.

shapeblock/call-to-action.name: shapeblock/call-to-action
shapeblock/call-to-action.title: Call to Action
shapeblock/call-to-action.description: A headline, a short line and one or two buttons, with an image, an icon or a background picture, to turn visitors into customers.

description.default: Tell people what they get and why now is the right time. Keep it to one or two short lines.

shapeblock/hover-box.name: shapeblock/hover-box
shapeblock/hover-box.title: Hover Box
shapeblock/hover-box.description: An image or icon in a circle or square that reveals a title and description on hover.

desc.default: A short line that appears when the pointer is over the box.

shapeblock/progress.name: shapeblock/progress
shapeblock/progress.title: Progress Bar
shapeblock/progress.description: A progress / skill bar with title and percent — two layout styles and full styling.

shapeblock/heading.name: shapeblock/heading
shapeblock/heading.title: Heading
shapeblock/heading.description: A heading with sub-heading, highlight, separator, gradient text and watermark.

shapeblock/column.name: shapeblock/column
shapeblock/column.title: Column
shapeblock/column.description: A column inside a ShapeBlock Row. Holds any block, including nested Rows.

shapeblock/contact-info.name: shapeblock/contact-info
shapeblock/contact-info.title: Contact Info
shapeblock/contact-info.description: Phone, email, address, opening times and more, each with an icon and a link that opens the right app.

shapeblock/search.name: shapeblock/search
shapeblock/search.title: Search
shapeblock/search.description: A site search — popup lightbox skin or inline search field skin, with full styling.

shapeblock/faq.name: shapeblock/faq
shapeblock/faq.title: Accordion
shapeblock/faq.description: An FAQ accordion with collapsible questions and custom icons.

default.title: What is ShapeBlock?
default.description: ShapeBlock is a custom addon plugin that offers useful blocks.

default.title: Does it work with the block editor?
default.description: Yes, it fully supports the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg).

default.title: How to install ShapeBlock?
default.description: Upload the plugin via WordPress Dashboard or FTP and activate it.

shapeblock/drop-caps.name: shapeblock/drop-caps
shapeblock/drop-caps.title: Drop Caps
shapeblock/drop-caps.description: A paragraph that opens with a large first letter across several lines, plain, in a box, outlined or as an outlined letter, with optional newspaper columns.

text.default: When the first shipment of walnut came in from a mill outside Lancaster, nobody at the shop had built anything bigger than a bookshelf. Three years and four hundred tables later, the same sawhorses still stand by the loading door, and we still check every board by hand before it goes on the bench.

shapeblock/icon-list.name: shapeblock/icon-list
shapeblock/icon-list.title: Icon List
shapeblock/icon-list.description: A list of items, each with an optional icon and a line of text.

shapeblock/button.name: shapeblock/button
shapeblock/button.title: Button
shapeblock/button.description: A flexible button with icon, gradient and full style controls.

shapeblock/paragraph.name: shapeblock/paragraph
shapeblock/paragraph.title: Paragraph
shapeblock/paragraph.description: A paragraph of text with its own typography, colour, alignment and highlighted words, set per device.

shapeblock/tab.name: shapeblock/tab
shapeblock/tab.title: Tabs
shapeblock/tab.description: Tabbed content with icon or image titles. Each tab holds any blocks, in a horizontal or vertical layout.

default.contentDescription: We are a passionate team crafting reliable products and services that help businesses grow. Since day one we have focused on quality, transparency, and building lasting relationships with every client we serve.
Our mission is to deliver simple, effective solutions to real problems. We make powerful tools accessible to everyone, backed by friendly support and a habit of continuous improvement.
We envision a future where great design and technology are within reach of every business. We lead with innovation, integrity, and a genuine commitment to our customers' success.

shapeblock/image-carousel.name: shapeblock/image-carousel
shapeblock/image-carousel.title: Image Carousel
shapeblock/image-carousel.description: A multi-image carousel with centered slides and continuous scrolling.

shapeblock/table.name: shapeblock/table
shapeblock/table.title: Table
shapeblock/table.description: A table edited in place, with a header, body and footer. Cells can hold text, images and icon lists, with colors and borders for the whole table or for each cell.

shapeblock/breadcrumb.name: shapeblock/breadcrumb
shapeblock/breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
shapeblock/breadcrumb.description: A dynamic breadcrumb trail for the current page, with home icon, separator and full styling.

shapeblock/filter-list.name: shapeblock/filter-list
shapeblock/filter-list.title: Filterable List
shapeblock/filter-list.description: A list of links with icons, filter buttons that show how many items each holds, and a search box to find an item.

shapeblock/google-map.name: shapeblock/google-map
shapeblock/google-map.title: Google Map
shapeblock/google-map.description: A Google map of one place or several, with a list of the places beside it, directions links and a look that suits the page.

shapeblock/clients-logo-grid.name: shapeblock/clients-logo-grid
shapeblock/clients-logo-grid.title: Client Logo
shapeblock/clients-logo-grid.description: A responsive grid of client / partner logos with links, grayscale and hover-swap effects.

shapeblock/icon-box.name: shapeblock/icon-box
shapeblock/icon-box.title: Icon Box
shapeblock/icon-box.description: Icon boxes with the icon on top, then title and description — icon, number or image supported.

desc.default: Your site loads in seconds with our highly optimized structure.

shapeblock/team-grid.name: shapeblock/team-grid
shapeblock/team-grid.title: Team Member
shapeblock/team-grid.description: A team member card typed in place, with 6 skins, social icons, email and phone, and an optional popup.

shapeblock/business-hours.name: shapeblock/business-hours
shapeblock/business-hours.title: Business Hours
shapeblock/business-hours.description: Opening hours for each day, with today highlighted and an Open now or Closed now badge that follows the site time.

shapeblock/image-comparison.name: shapeblock/image-comparison
shapeblock/image-comparison.title: Image Comparison
shapeblock/image-comparison.description: A before / after image comparison slider with a draggable handle — horizontal or vertical.

shapeblock/testimonials-grid.name: shapeblock/testimonials-grid
shapeblock/testimonials-grid.title: Testimonial
shapeblock/testimonials-grid.description: A grid of testimonials with three styles, ratings, quote icons and logos.

shapeblock/offcanvas.name: shapeblock/offcanvas
shapeblock/offcanvas.title: Offcanvas
shapeblock/offcanvas.description: A toggle button that opens an off-canvas panel rendering a selected Template — classic side or modern fullscreen.

shapeblock/menu.name: shapeblock/menu

shapeblock/menu.description: Build a navigation menu inside the block — add links and dropdowns, pick pages, descriptions, new-tab links, plus a responsive mobile menu.

shapeblock/social-icon.name: shapeblock/social-icon
shapeblock/social-icon.title: Social Icon
shapeblock/social-icon.description: A row of linked social icons with per-icon or global colors, hover states and full button styling.
